extension.proof: Only a successful exact own-file validator command followed by the literal EXIT=$? or exit=$? echo, a matching VALID marker and a final zero status may be treated as equivalent to canonical validation. Original transcripts are unchanged; proof is added to the receipt. Denied and ambiguous calls remain invalid.

execution_permission_boundary.qualification: Five accepted ratings precede the validator-status permission extension and 51 follow it. Scoring prompts, definitions and inputs are unchanged, but execution permissions differ. Cohort comparisons and repeat panels spanning this boundary do not isolate permission effects; small differences cannot be attributed solely to generation version or evaluator variability.

execution_deadline_boundary.qualification: Seventeen accepted ratings precede the execution deadline increase from 900 to 1800 seconds; 39 follow it.
